title: Concept: conda channel configured over cleartext
description: environment.yml declares a channel URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Packages cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can serve a different build of the same name and version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through environment.yml (conda).
risk: Packages cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can serve a different build of the same name and version.
